paper_title: 3D template-based $Fermi$-LAT constraints on the diffuse supernova axion-like particle background
notes: Diffuse supernova ALP background searched via Fermi-LAT. The benchmark 95% CL upper limit is g_agamma <= 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a << 10^-11 eV. This is a stellar/cosmological bound (not a DM haloscope), so no DM density assumed.
